file_stem: RWB E1 042 Central configuration service and parameter catalog
title: Central configuration service and parameter catalog
goal: Every setting and business value is read from one service and catalogued with an owner; no hard-coded numbers
why: Business values like the 90-day entry threshold change by approved data, not by release, and each decision records the parameter version it used.
ace_note: No ACE read. Parameters are Workbench configuration; secrets stay in the secret store.

writes.note: key, type, range, owner, environments, used-by
versioned value per environment and date

stores: config/parameter-catalog.csv in the repo; secret store; outbox ParameterVersionApproved

path.text: Squad adds key to catalog CSV

rules: BR1: business values are versioned parameter rows, never constants
BR2: every parameter has an owner, type, default, environments and used-by
BR6: secrets stay in the secret store only
BR7: the service does not start without its required parameters
risks: Literal business value in code -> build fails
Required value missing at start -> service does not start (MSG-P3-032)
example: Entry evaluation on 2026-12-01 reads 90 from the service and records parameter version 1
